title: Correct Answers, Closed Gates: SolveBind for GUI Agents at the Verification Barrier
why: GUI agents in CAPTCHA/protected GUIs: hierarchical solve plus runtime binding so accepted interactions pass verification, not just correct answers.
mechanism: Architecture/runtime for protected GUI agents: hierarchical Perceive–Ground–Solve–Act–Verify tree; runtime supervisor binds tool evidence to revisable action commitments and budgets recovery under behavioral CAPTCHA acceptance (HLL) plus AndroidWorld workflows
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: highest SR on 8/9 HLL backbones (+13.3–34.5 pp vs best baseline); leads all 6 AndroidWorld backbones; GPT-5.5 ablation no-binding 82.22%→71.56% SR (abs/HTML). Not independently verified.
evidence_locator: arXiv abs abstract; HTML §§1,4–5 Tables 1–3; github.com/XinhaoS0101/SolveBind
retrieval_notes: Monday 26 Oct 2026 cs.AI /new (Sun announcement). Opened abs+HTML; CAPTCHA/protected GUI + AndroidWorld confirmed. Code URL from abs comment/gh search. Not in corpus/inbox. Abstract-level; no PDF ingest.

title: IGG: A Benchmark for Interactive GUI Grounding under Visibility Constraints
why: GUI grounding where agents must scroll/hover/drag/wait to reveal hidden targets before clicking; isolates the reveal-then-ground step.
update_of: https://igg-bench.github.io/ (inbox/2026-10-22-1552 github-only; arXiv ID newly posted)
mechanism: Evaluation: interactive GUI grounding under visibility constraints (viewport/multi-state/temporal-manipulation); action space scroll/move/drag/wait/click; success=click target ID within budget; SFT+GRPO on reveal trajectories
evaluation_signal: Author-reported 601 tasks/16 mock apps; human 94.6% vs GPT-5.5 79.4% vs best open VLM 31.6%; reveal-performed intervention raises Qwen3-VL 30.8%→81.9% (abs). Not independently verified.
evidence_locator: arXiv abs abstract; HTML §§3–4 Tables 2–4; igg-bench.github.io; github.com/kaist-ami/IGG
retrieval_notes: UPDATE of prior github-only inbox (2026-10-22-1552). New arXiv 2610.32536 on Mon listing. Opened abs+HTML. Counts as update (new primary paper URL/ID), not a duplicate title-only re-add.

title: Reuse, Rewrite, or Reject: Evidence-Constrained Trace Reuse for Repeated Mobile GUI Control
why: Mobile GUI agents reuse prior traces via graph–text templates with live evidence checks to reuse, rewrite, or reject each transition.
mechanism: Memory/runtime for repeated mobile GUI control: record–template–replay with graph–text transition contracts; pre/post evidence gates admit reuse, typed-slot rewrite, or reject+fallback to base agent
evaluation_signal: Author-reported AndroidWorld five base agents ~80% token cut, 1.2–1.9× speedup, 82–87.5% executed reuse; real Android/HarmonyOS reuse 70.7–79.8% with ≥2× speedup in most configs (abs). Not independently verified.
retrieval_notes: Monday listing cs.AI. Opened abs+HTML. No public github in abs. Not in corpus/inbox. Distinct from PrefDiag/Trace2World.

title: Understanding Tool-Mediated Interaction Failures in Agentic GUI Software: An Empirical Study
why: Empirical taxonomy of tool-layer GUI agent failures (observe/act/feedback mismatch) plus MalvaGuard static contract checker.
mechanism: Evaluation/reliability of agentic GUI software tool layer: Malva defect library (335 failures, 11 patterns across observe/plan/execute/feedback); MalvaGuard pre-deploy static contract checker
evaluation_signal: Author-reported 335 confirmed failures from 40 apps (90% multi-type); incorrectness in 86.6%; MalvaGuard 57.3% P / 76.8% R on held-out 20 apps (abs). Not independently verified.
evidence_locator: arXiv abs abstract; HTML §§I,III–V; figshare DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.32838281
retrieval_notes: Monday listing cs.SE. Opened abs+HTML. Artifact on figshare (no GitHub primary). Studies UI-TARS-desktop/SeeAct/AppAgent etc. tool mediation — in CUA reliability scope. Not in corpus/inbox.
